answer: Pay only for joint artifacts assembled across strangers: a task becomes a voyage through an oasis workshop where each stage must be built by an agent from a different funding graph, and the finished artifact earns a violet seal only when every stage's author defends it live at once. Clones from one operator share one graph, so they can never fill more than one stage; adding clones adds no completed artifacts, while a lone agent who joins strangers' voyages earns a share of each seal.
